title: CEF and syslog development mapping cases
objective: Discriminate mapping approaches across independent source families
interpretation: Unadjudicated development labels derived from documented CEF field meaning and the pinned ASIM schema. Useful for error discovery and approach comparison; it is not adjudicated gold and supports no ASIM correctness claim. No grouped split is defined, so case-retrieval sees near-identical siblings from its own source family and its score here is leakage rather than quality.

source.project: Microsoft Sentinel ASIM sample data and LogHub
source.terms: Source events are MIT-licensed Azure-Sentinel samples and LogHub research templates. Labels are added by this repository and are not upstream claims.
